scripts.test: pnpm build && vitest run --exclude test/remote-artifact-builder.test.ts --exclude test/ssh-remote-daemon.integration.test.ts --exclude test/package-consumer.integration.test.ts && vitest run test/remote-artifact-builder.test.ts && vitest run test/ssh-remote-daemon.integration.test.ts && vitest run test/package-consumer.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:security: pnpm build && vitest run test/daemon-security.test.ts test/acp-adapter.test.ts test/hook-server.test.ts test/managed-hook-installer.test.ts test/ssh-daemon-connector.test.ts test/ssh-remote-daemon.test.ts
scripts.test:fuzz: pnpm build && AGENTMUX_FUZZ_SEED=1592619015 vitest run test/daemon-security.test.ts -t 'malformed and oversized frames'
scripts.test:chaos: pnpm build && vitest run test/daemon-reliability.integration.test.ts test/daemon-crash.integration.test.ts && vitest run test/ssh-remote-daemon.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:conformance: pnpm build && vitest run test/run-kernel-conformance.test.ts test/run-kernel-statistics.test.ts test/daemon-reliability.integration.test.ts test/daemon-crash.integration.test.ts && vitest run --maxWorkers=1 test/ssh-remote-daemon.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:stress: pnpm build && AGENTMUX_STRESS_SEED=7007 node scripts/soak-daemon-resources.mjs && AGENTMUX_STRESS=1 vitest run test/ssh-remote-daemon.integration.test.ts -t 'repeated deterministic SSH transport partitions'
